missionPremise: OPS-24 Phase 0 requires the six onboarded counties complete and verified, and the 2026-09-17 07:29Z six-county grade (_inbox/2026-09-17_six_county_completeness_post_apply.json, carried in the dispatch) shows eight ledger rails holding 100k-380k unaccounted cells each. The dispatch's premise is that most of that is not acquisition debt but writer debt, and the store read at close confirms the grade cell-for-cell. The premise it gets wrong, measured: for three of the rails the debt is not a code defect at all -- acreageSqft and landUseVintage have derivations that are pure functions of the county's own cell and their cells were simply still at rail-instantiate because no pass had run for those counties, and citationUrl's `excluded-no-acquisition-path` verdict is not a finding that no acquisition path exists but classifyExclusion's conservative default for a declared-ahead rail with zero earned cells program-wide. PLAN-ROW P-266 and P-268 are the two OPS-16 rows that own this, and the lane's job is to make each rail resolve from the parcel's own source or to name, with a count and a basis, why it cannot -- never to satisfy a count.
completionPredicate: Done means: (1) every rail this lane changed resolves from the parcel's own source with both directions tested -- a parcel whose source carries the value gets the value, a parcel whose source is silent gets an honest absence or no write at all; (2) every must-pass refusal group is either fixed in code or carries a count and a basis that sum to the measured refusal count, so the operator can rule it; (3) the integration seat has the exact per-county writer commands and a per-county/per-rail prediction its next grade can be checked against; (4) nothing was applied, written, deployed or merged by this lane. A stranger can evaluate (1) and (4) from the PR and the store, (2) from the refusalGroups below, and (3) from the measured dry runs below. The lane's own status is closed-partial because the dispatch defines done as the gate's verdicts AFTER the applies, which this lane does not run.
